Left PER.why: Histology says this probe is not in Left PER, and does not say where it is instead. There is no region label that could honestly go on these channels, so nothing is computed from them.

Left PER.member: DEWEY r7 s2 Precon2 SPC · Click → High tone · state
Left PER.why: Histology puts this probe in Left entorhinal cortex, not Left PER. The signal is real; the label is not the one on the map, and it is drawn under its own name.  The same cell asks for a second opinion, so the relocation itself is not settled. A circuit leaves relocated probes out entirely, so this region is grey even though Coupling computes it.

method: DerSimonian-Laird random effects; BH across each panel
notes: With few recordings per side the z test on a DerSimonian-Laird pooled mean is optimistic: tau2 is estimated imprecisely and treated as known, so p and q come out smaller than they should. Read a q near the threshold with that in mind.
